C07 and C24 share much of the same machinery, but C10 is the closest literal and structural match.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Whereas the Fourth International Automation Congress and Exposition is to be held at New York, New York, from June 9 to June 13, 1958","parent_excerpt":"Whereas the Second Annual United States World Trade Fair is to be held at New York, New York, from May 7 to May 17, 1958, inclusive","explanation":"Parallel opening recital identifies an upcoming New York exhibition and its dates."},{"child_excerpt":"the Congress, by a joint resolution approved April 11, 1958, has authorized the President of the United States of America to invite the several States and foreign countries to take part","parent_excerpt":"the Congress, by a joint resolution approved March 28, 1958 (72 Stat. 70), has authorized the President...to invite the States of the Union and foreign countries to participate","explanation":"Distinctive shared legal premise and invitation mechanism."},{"child_excerpt":"thereby promoting foreign and domestic commerce and fostering friendly relations among participating nations","parent_excerpt":"will tend to encourage further development of international trade and to foster friendly relations among participating nations","explanation":"Closely shared statement of commercial and diplomatic purposes, including the exact phrase about friendly relations among participating nations."},{"child_excerpt":"do hereby invite the several States and foreign countries to participate...in the Coliseum at New York, New York","parent_excerpt":"do hereby invite the States of the Union and foreign countries to participate...in the Coliseum in New York, New York","explanation":"The operative invitation follows virtually the same wording and venue-specific structure."}]}
